name: design-system-tools
description: Turn a repository's DESIGN.md and the stylesheets behind it into a claude.ai Design System, and keep the two in step: align-design-md finds where the record drifted from the component code and rewrites it, customize-design rebrands the direction tokens in every theme scope (scaffolding them first when a project has none) with every contrast ratio measured, and from-design-md publishes the result as a Design System artifact with tokens in every theme, a brand book, static previews and a cover
